translation_en.text: He sat on a very high chair. He ate with a very long fork.

items.text: Aliacha nyumba yake na kuishi katika msitu mkubwa. Aliishi kwa miaka mingi.

translation_en.text: He left his house and lived in a big forest. He lived for many years.

items.text: Mbuzi, Mbwa na Ng'ombe walikuwa marafiki wa karibu sana. Siku moja walisafiri kwa teksi.

translation_en.text:
Goat, Dog, and Cow
were great friends. One
day they went on a
journey in a taxi.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0004_mbuzi-mbwa-na-ngombe.md p1; Text: Fabian Wakholi; Illustration: Marleen Visser, Ingrid Schechter; Translation: Brigid Simiyu

items.label: beta

can_do: B1.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B1
items.text: Walipofika mwisho wa safari yao, dereva aliwaomba walipe nauli zao. Ng'ombe alilipa nauli yake.

translation_en.text:
When they reached the
end of their journey, the
driver asked them to
pay their fares. Cow
paid her fare.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0004_mbuzi-mbwa-na-ngombe.md p2; Text: Fabian Wakholi; Illustration: Marleen Visser, Ingrid Schechter; Translation: Brigid Simiyu

items.text: Dereva alipokaribia kumpa Mbwa chenji yake, Mbuzi alitoroka bila kulipa chochote.

translation_en.text:
The driver was about to
give Dog his change
when Goat ran away
without paying
anything.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0004_mbuzi-mbwa-na-ngombe.md p4; Text: Fabian Wakholi; Illustration: Marleen Visser, Ingrid Schechter; Translation: Brigid Simiyu

items.text: Dereva alikasirika sana. Aliondoka bila kumrudishia Mbwa chenji yake.

translation_en.text:
The driver was very
annoyed. He drove
away without giving
Dog his change.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0004_mbuzi-mbwa-na-ngombe.md p5; Text: Fabian Wakholi; Illustration: Marleen Visser, Ingrid Schechter; Translation: Brigid Simiyu

items.text: Mbuzi hukimbia anaposikia mlio wa gari. Anaogopa atakamatwa kwa kutolipa nauli.

translation_en.text:
Goat runs away from
the sound of a car. She
is afraid she will be
arrested for not paying
her fare.

As she went out the door, she
hugged me and said, "Bye for
now."

follow her but dad lifted me up
on his shoulder.

to the hospital to have a baby."

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0013_barua-kwa-mama.md p5; Text: Ursula Nafula; Illustration: Catherine Groenewald; Translation: Ursula Nafula

items.text: Niliposikia “mtoto”, niliacha kulia na kumwangalia baba. “Kwa nini anaenda kumpata mtoto hospitalini?”, nilimuuliza.

translation_en.text:
When I heard "baby" I stopped
crying and looked at him.
"Why is she going to get the

Baki humu pangoni
nikatafute chakula. Na usipike nyama kamwe. Majitu hupenda
sana harufu ya nyama.
Labda hakuna majitu,

Pengine mjomba
alisema kuna majitu ili kututisha tu.

Nina hakika hakuna hatari nikichoma nyama kwa moto huu.
Chakula cha kuchomwa ni kitamu.
Ulichomaje nyama bila moto?
Nilichoma nyama hii kwenye jua nje ya pango,
Hapana, wewe si kakangu. sauti hiyo si yake.
Tafadhali baba,

naomba unisaidie. Nimeumia
mguu. Naomba maji ya kunywa.
Ngoja nikuletee maji lakini usiguse mfuko wangu.

Kuna mlo mtamu ndani ya mfuko. Nenda
ukaulete!
Inauma, inauma...

Waondoshe hapo hao kuku
wachafu Refiloe!

Siwataki popote karibu na
hema la harusi.

Torokeni enyi
viumbe washienzi,

Sitaki
mliwe kwenye harusi ya Palesa.

Mama asema kwamba hii itakuwa harusi ya kufana
zaidi katika Malealea,

Na anasema kwamba ninaweza kuwasaidia
wasichana wale wakubwa na upishi.
Refiloe!

acha hao kuku wako na uje
kunisaidia na hivi vyungu tafadhali!
Tokeni nje!

Tokeni nje ninyi viumbe vya miguu na
midomo michafu!

Mama
anasema ukweli, mnaaibisha,

nina wazao zuri
mno.

Tafadhali binti yangu usitoroke, mimi ni
mamako. Nimejibadilisha kuwa samaki ili babako
asigundue kwamba ni mimi.
Ni nini ndiyo shida?

Usiwe na wasiwasi msichana wangu. Nitakuletea
chakula kila siku,

Kuna jambo linatendeka kule mtoni, na lazima
nigundue ni nini,
Lazima nifanye jambo kumhusu huyu samaki,
Nini kibaya mke wangu mrembo?

Mganga wa kienyeji aliniambia kwamba njia pekee
ya kukuzalia mtoto mvulana ni kwa kumla samaki
mkubwa anayeishi kwenye mto ulio karibu hapa,
Utanishikia yule samaki usiku wa leo?
Nitakufanyia lolote bibi yangu mrembo,
Nitatayarisha kitoweo kizuri kwetu,
Hili ni jambo geni,

Babangu
huamka mapema mno kwenda mashambani.
Nastaajabu kwa nini yeye bado analala.

sana. Ebu tupumzike kidogo chini ya kivuli cha mti.
Nyanya, mbuyu huyu ni mzee sana, sivyo?

Ndiyo, Selma. Lakini sio mzee au mkubwa zaidi ya mbuyu ulio
katika kijiji cha Ombalantu!
Ombalantu? Kijiji hicho ki karibu?
Tafadhali tueleze kuhusu mti huo,
Basi keti usikilize,
Angula,

Mjomba, kimbia, kimbia! Kuna wanaume wanaokuja kuiba
ng'ombe na kutuchomea nyumba.
Shangazi, kimbia, kimbia!

Babu, kimbia, kimbia, wanaume wanakuja
kuiba ng'ombe wetu na kuchoma nyumba zetu.

Kimbieni, kimbieni. Kuna wanaume wanaokuja kuiba
ng'ombe wetu na kuchoma nyumba zetu!

turns.text: Usinisumbue na hayo, wewe ni mjinga huwezi kujifunza chochote.
Hujambo, naitwa Tomaso. Nafanya kazi karibu hapa, pahali ambapo unaweza kupata chakula,
Natumaini utaenda pale kupata chakula kidogo?
Labda,
Hadithi inahusu nini?
Inahusu mvulana aliekuakuwa rubani,
Jina lake ni nani?
Sijui, siwezi kusoma,
Nadhani wakati umewadia wa wewe kwenda shule ili ujisomee hadithi hii mwenyewe. Unaonaje?
Labda ni heri kubaki mitaani,
Hadithi inahusu nini?
Inahusu mvulana ambaye ni mwalimu,
